notes.title: Maintenance Schedule & Update Note
notes.notes:
❗Commanders, servers will be undergoing maintenance for update:

Thursday 2025/05/15, 6:00 UTC
Duration: 2 hours

-----------------------------------------------

📝Update Note:

➡️Glorious Anniversary Celebration
-Daily login and event collection, Celebration Rewards never stop!
-New milestone missions: join all Commanders server-wide to win the final reward!
-Review the achievements of the past year and thank every Commander for making the Renney Sector so wonderful!
-Christmas & Spring Festival ships return for a limited time to boost the Celebration!
-Lucky Reorganizer joins the Celebration—who will be the next lucky one!
-Pilot your ship and complete the Expansion Operation for continuous rewards!

MISCELLANEOUS

➡️New ship: Vexora Dreadnought (To Be Released)
- Vexora: can carry 3 subships—Mothership incoming!
- Vexora has been added to the Gaia Manual, to be released in a future update in Matrix Servers first. Stay tuned!

➡️New personal research type: Re-activatable Research
- Unlocked after reaching certain Progress in Station/Matrix Research Path
- Each research grants one activation attempt, the number of activations is not cumulative and grants a time-limited buff upon activation

- Added a new generic ship coating the for Sleigh of Joy Battleship, no need to celebrate Christmas all year anymore!

- To provide a better experience for all commanders, we added a small amount of lower-strength normal and elite Scavengers to older servers

- You can now buy some past event avatar frames for GEC or SCC

- Adjusted the recycling prices for some ship Coating items

- Added missions to complete a certain number of Member Quests in the Republic mission system

- Editing fleets with the Quick Formation button in the Dock will now prioritize the Admiral with the highest leadership

- Text can now be included when sending coordinates

- Ship skills related to Comprehensive Ratings will now display the final effects when the ships are assembled

- Optimized the display of the world event stage 2 Ranking and the display of commander information

- Optimized the display of the alliance member authorities into a list format for better clarity

- Optimized the display of the Starry Treasure event prompt. Now, it will only display once per day when you log in the game.

- In Galaxy Elysium, commander server ID is now displayed in the alliance list

- Title Selection Crates will now display Obtained Effect and Equipped Effect of the Title

- Increased the amount of free refresh for industrial ship research from 2 to 4 times

- Ship leadership will now be displayed in Gaia Manual

- Bonuses from Matrix Research will now be displayed when viewing ship stats in Matrix Stage

- In events, removed regular Scavengers from the solar system info panel to display special Scavengers instead

- When tapping on a wormhole, allied, enemy, and Force fleets will now be displayed with distinct colours

- Changed the Admiral Memory Expansion Pack obtained from the Monthly Log-in event to an Admiral Skill Crate

- Email notifying an Alliance building has been scanned will now only be sent to the Alliance managers

notes.title: Patch Note & Event Schedule
notes.notes:
📝 Weekly Update:

These changes will be in effect shortly, please restart your game in a moment to download the update.

--------------------------------

- Increased the 2nd skill effect of Melinoe Battleship

Increases the damage of fleet subweaponry skills by 17%(50%) → 28%(80%) in combat (Subweaponry skills are the ones that launch an extra salvo after a certain amount of attacks from the ships' weapons)

- Emergency Shields

1. Added email notification for the Emergency Quantum Shield activated after the space station is forced out of its original solar system location.
2. When commanders' space stations are forced to leave the original solar system locations, if there's no Quantum Shield activated, a 2-hour Emergency Quantum Shield will be activated. If there is a Quantum Shield activated, and the remaining time is below 2 hours, a 2-hour Emergency Quantum Shield will be applied; if the remaining time is above 2 hours, the 2-hour Emergency Quantum Shield will not be applied.
